item.title: Too Good To Be True?: Fact Checking DIY Menstrual Masks
item.description: Evidence from dermatology and science credits zero points to the benefits of menstrual masking and reiterates the potential harm in using menstrual blood as a healing face mask. The post Too Good To Be True?: Fact Checking DIY Menstrual Masks appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Is Trauma Dumping A New Label For Women’s Emotional Expression Online?
item.description: It is not a new problem because it is just a new term for a century-old societal habit of suppressing women’s vulnerability and labelling their feelings as a ‘burden’. The post Is Trauma Dumping A New Label For Women’s Emotional Expression Online? appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: The Region And Its Icons: The Various Contradictions Of Hindutva Nation-Building In Bengal
item.description: While an insult to the language and maligning of icons might have wounded the Bhadralok Bengali psyche, the BJP's recent attacks have materially affected the most disenfranchised communities in West Bengal—the Dalit and Muslim working classes. The post The Region And Its Icons: The Various Contradictions Of Hindutva Nation-Building In Bengal appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: From Rishta To Risk: Scams And AI Morphing Fueling Gendered Violence On Indian Matrimonial Sites
item.description: Real women’s pictures and names are used to create phony matrimonial or social media profiles to defame, damage their reputation or facilitate extortion. The post From Rishta To Risk: Scams And AI Morphing Fueling Gendered Violence On Indian Matrimonial Sites appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: This World AIDS Day, Learn About India’s First PrEP/PEP Locator
item.description: Launched by Safe Access to make HIV Prevention more accessible to Indians, this Locator tool is a community-sourced directory of healthcare providers offering HIV prevention care in an inclusive and affirming manner for the LGBTQ+ population The post This World AIDS Day, Learn About India’s First PrEP/PEP Locator appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: On The Future Of Queer Comedy In India: In Conversation With Aayushi Jagad
item.description: In this exclusive interview, Queer-Rated Comedy's Aayushi Jagad performs her piece about her relationship with bisexuality and discusses her career at Pune's Comedy Clubhouse. The post On The Future Of Queer Comedy In India: In Conversation With Aayushi Jagad appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Humans In The Loop Review: Adivasi Women’s Labor In AI Training And Quiet Rebellion Of Mothers
item.description: Humans In The Loop is not a film about technology; it is a tender, fierce portrait of the quiet rebellion of mothers who refuse to be mislabelled. The post Humans In The Loop Review: Adivasi Women’s Labor In AI Training And Quiet Rebellion Of Mothers appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Beyond The Ramp: Expanding The Definition Of Access For Persons With Disabilities
item.description: To build a more inclusive future, we must begin by expanding our imagination of what access truly means for people with disabilities. The post Beyond The Ramp: Expanding The Definition Of Access For Persons With Disabilities appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Deepa Parab And All-Women Bouncer Squad: From Providing Security To Claiming The Public Space
item.description: In a profession long ruled by men, the group has turned the idea of women's safety on its head. The post Deepa Parab And All-Women Bouncer Squad: From Providing Security To Claiming The Public Space appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: In Search Of Leisure: Stories Of Bengaluru’s Informal Women Workers
item.description: While juggling paid and unpaid work, women in Bengaluru's informal economy redefine what leisure means to them. The post In Search Of Leisure: Stories Of Bengaluru’s Informal Women Workers appeared first on Feminism in India.
